messages:
sam_sales: Heads up 1 BigFinance legal asked for a 'forensic-ready' bundle for the POC: they want event exports suitable for Splunk ingestion, a precise retention policy extract, examples of admin actions (create/revoke token, role grant, model rollback), and cryptographic proof the export wasn't altered. Can we assemble and ship today?

nina_sol: Yes. We'll include: NDJSON export, a CSV mapping to Splunk/CEF fields, retention JSON snippet, an admin-action sample set, and a signature file. Question: do they need real IPs or redacted?

ops_ben: POC exports default to minimal PII: email usernames masked, IPs truncated to /24. If they sign an NDA we can provide full fidelity. For now provide redacted samples and note redaction rules. Export command we'll use (internal):

```
redwoodctl export-logs --from 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z --to 2026-11-07T23:59:59Z --kinds admin,auth,token,deploy --format ndjson --dest /tmp/bigfinance_poc.ndjson --redact pii,ip
```

ops_ben: Sample NDJSON (anonymized):

```
{"ts":"2026-11-03T08:11:02Z","event":"admin.role.grant","actor":"ui:console:s.jones","actor_source":"ui","target":"user:ex-01","details":"granted:admin","request_id":"req-77a"}
{"ts":"2026-11-03T08:12:33Z","event":"token.revoke","actor":"api:svc:orchestrator","actor_source":"api","target":"token:eb-44","details":"revoked_by:automated-rotation","request_id":"req-77b"}
{"ts":"2026-11-04T12:22:10Z","event":"model.rollback","actor":"tom_engineer","actor_source":"api","target":"model:redwood-13b","details":"to_version:v2","reason":"regression_alert","request_id":"req-81c"}
{"ts":"2026-11-05T17:45:00Z","event":"auth.mfa.failure","actor":"auth:oauth","actor_source":"system","target":"user:bn","details":"method:webauthn"}
```

nina_sol: For Splunk well include sourcetype: "redwood:events:ndjson" and a short HEC example. Also provide a CEF mapping for SIEM teams who want normalized fields (deviceExternalId=request_id, dvc=region, src=ip).

sec_jill: Retention: hosted default = 90 days (retention.default_days=90). Dedicated deployments support customer-configurable retention up to 10 years with optional archival to customer-managed S3. I'll attach the exact retention-policy JSON we export for audits. Snippet: `{"retention": {"default_days":"90","max_days":"3650","archival_s3":"s3://customer-archives/BigFinance/"}}`.

sec_jill: Tamper evidence: we provide a canonicalization step (normalize line endings, sort keys) then compute a SHA-256 over the compressed tarball and sign with our PKCS7 key. Offer also an HMAC using customer-supplied KMS key for direct verification. We'll add an explanation of canonicalization steps in the README.

auditbot: CAIQ/SIG mapping note: attached CSV will map CAIQ control ids to our event types. Example row: CCM.Logging-1, admin.role.grant, req-77a. We'll also highlight which events map to "Admin Activity" vs "System" vs "User" for SIG reviewers.

ops_ben: Also including an events index CSV: event_type,example_ts,actor_source,sample_id so BigFinance's SIEM folks can quickly glance.

sam_sales: Good. They also asked for evidence of account-level admin actions being immutable. Do we have examples of immutable audit entries (append-only, write-once storage)?

tom_engineer: Yes 1 audit trail storage is append-only in our object store with write-once lifecycle and object-versioning enabled. We'll include S3 object metadata for a sample export (object version id, creation time) as proof. Also include our retention S3 lifecycle rules snippet.

nina_sol: Privacy: confirm redaction policy in the cover page and include point-of-contact for contested records. We'll also include a short note on how to request full fidelity (NDA + signed JML request).

sec_jill: Final bundle items: 1) sample_bigfinance_ndjson.ndjson (redacted) 2) mapping_splunk.csv 3) caiq_mapping.csv 4) retention_policy.json 5) audit_object_metadata.txt 6) sha256.txt 7) signature.p7s 8) README.md (one page scope & redaction).

sam_sales: ETA to assemble & presign link?

ops_ben: I'll build the bundle and upload to a pre-signed S3 link by EOD 2026-11-07 PST. Will post link here and ping @bigfinance-sales.

sam_sales: Thanks team. Please call out in README that IPs are truncated and emails masked unless they sign NDA. Also note TF: we used canonical json-sort+gzip before hashing.

nina_sol: Will add Splunk HEC example and a short CEF conversion snippet.

sam_sales: Perfect. Once uploaded I'll forward to legal & BigFinance procurement.
